about: Mount Pearl is a city on Newfoundland and Labrador’s Avalon Peninsula, immediately southwest of St. John’s. It is a dense residential and commercial suburb with its own downtown along Commonwealth Avenue, distinct from the capital yet fully inside the metro area. Parks, arenas, and big-box retail define much of daily life. About 22,000 people live in Mount Pearl.
seoSummary: Dense residential city southwest of St. John’s—Newfoundland’s second-largest urban centre.
